publications.title: ACE-272: A Retrospective Benchmark of Enterprise Trust Risks in Language-Model Endpoints
publications.abstract: A retrospective study of nine language-model endpoints evaluated across six enterprise trust domains, with explicit scope, scoring, and attribution limits.
